{"consolidated_memory":"**LOCATION:** storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql

**ISSUE HISTORY:** Two distinct lock timeout problems in migration 0042, both manifesting as lock waits that trip the statement timeout, each with its own root cause and resolution.

**OCCASION 1 - 2026-03-13:**
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Signal: lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and implemented a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR/Branch: #2730 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1
- Reproduction: run migration against loaded table
- Outcome: flaky test reduced from 88 failures per hundred runs to zero

**OCCASION 2 - 2026-07-12:**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Signal: lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR/Branch: #6914 on branch fix/lock-timeout-2
- Reproduction: run migration against loaded table
- Outcome: job execution time improved from 9 hours to 36 minutes

Both occasions involved storage-side work on the same migration file and were reproduced by running the migration against a loaded table."}
